adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, explicitly appends additional host destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);` in `handleNewBooking.ts`). However, when persisting the booking, it only connects the first destination calendar (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`), dropping the rest. Subsequent flows shown in the diff (e.g., `confirm.handler.ts`, `paypal-webhook.ts`, `webhook.ts`) rebuild `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (singular) into a single-element array, so they can only act on the persisted first calendar and will miss the other hosts’ calendars for post-booking actions (payment/confirmation).
